settlement_source: Federal Reserve System (FOMC statement / federalreserve.gov press release)
settlement_variable: FOMC decision on the target federal funds rate range at the specified meeting: hike by X bps / cut / no change (mutually exclusive bins)
timezone: ET (last trading 1:55 PM ET per PDF; expiration 2:05 PM ET)
tie_handling: N/A; outcomes mutually exclusive (e.g. a 50bp hike resolves only that bin Yes).
rounding: Bins by bps change of target range; no rounding specified (handling of non-25bp-multiple moves: unknown)
trading_close_vs_settlement: PDF: last trading 1:55 PM ET; expiration first 2:05 PM ET after decision release (statement normally 2:00 PM ET), so trading stops BEFORE release. API close_time 2026-10-28T17:59Z; expiration_time 2027-01-27 is 3-month backstop; settlement_timer 297s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: If Fed cancels the target meeting: 'no change' bin Yes, all others No. Kalshi may open Market Outcome Review at sole discretion; if value undeterminable Kalshi decides payouts per Rule 6.3(b). Post-expiry revisions ignored. Unscheduled intermeeting moves: unknown/not addressed.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'Hike rates by 0bps' for the hold bin (yes_sub_title 'Fed maintains rate'): awkward wording
rules_secondary example has garbled 'Hike   25 bps' label text
PDF says the 'Instructions' link is convenience-only, not binding

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: Federal Reserve press releases
public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.latency: ~2:00 PM ET on decision day, after market close

toxicity_flags: Decision is released after trading closes, but futures/fedspeak price it ~90%+ in advance (hold bin 0.91-0.92): informed rates-futures flow
Press lock-up leak risk (MNPI prohibition applies)
Far-tail bins (0.01-0.08) are lottery-like and negative EV after fees
notes: FOMC decision bins, ~8/yr. Sample KXFEDDECISION-26OCT-H0 had close_time 2026-10-28 yet refresh still lists it open (likely awaiting settlement). Source PDF FEDDECISION.pdf.
